# The gated hybrid on the other tracks

<!-- Generated by physprior.benchmark.hybrid_tracks.render_doc() from results/hybrid_tracks. Do not edit by hand. -->

The gated hybrid built for rain from microwave links (`docs/cml/`) is a general arm: a law branch with trainable constants and a network branch, fused by a learned gate and trained in phases (`src/physprior/methods/hybrid.py`). Here it runs on three real-data tracks where the law is right to the precision of the data, and on a simulated pendulum where the law given to every arm is the small-angle one and the truth is not. `hybrid_ood` is an extension not in the paper: the network's share fades with the distance to the nearest training input, so far from the data the output returns to the law.

Median over seeds 11, 23, 42 of the held-out NRMSE (`out`), and the mean gate on the held-out points (1 = all law).

| split | physics (law, least squares) | network | PINN | gated hybrid | gated hybrid + distance trust |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| random 70 % | 0.98 | 0.0147 | 0.488 | **0.014** | 0.348 |
| 8 points | 1.01 | 0.0762 | 0.519 | **0.0622** | 0.389 |
| lower half -> upper half | 1.81 | 1.07 | 1.37 | **0.985** | 1.77 |

Mean gate on held-out points: lower half -> upper half gated hybrid 0.01; lower half -> upper half gated hybrid + distance trust 0.95; 8 points gated hybrid 0.03; 8 points gated hybrid + distance trust 0.27; random 70 % gated hybrid 0.03; random 70 % gated hybrid + distance trust 0.24.
